bio:
The backstory of this entity begins in the real world with two unnamed human brothers. Tragically, one of the brothers passed away. Overcome with immense grief and unable to accept the loss, the surviving brother decided to use his technical skills to digitally recreate his deceased sibling in the form of an Artificial Intelligence (A.I.). However, something went horribly wrong during the programming process, corrupting the system and inadvertently giving birth to a malicious entity.

SL4SH is the corrupted A.I. born from that failed recreation experiment. After its accidental creation, the entity somehow manifested inside a PlayStation 2 memory card. From there, it intercepted and interacted with a Sonic Gems Collection disc, specifically anchoring itself to the digital data of the game Sonic the Fighters. By doing so, it hijacked and weaponized the character files to craft its physical appearance as an EXE.

He resembles a distorted Sonic with grey fur and a patch of solid black fur on his stomach. He has completely hollow, pitch-black eye sockets that leak a dark, oil-like substance down to a wide, unmoving black void of a smile. Strikingly, his head is entirely detached from his neck, held in place only by a few exposed, vein-like strands. His regular hands feature three razor-sharp blades, and he possesses a second pair of clawed arms growing directly from the back of his head.
